windowclass.name: quicksummon_unsummon
windowclass.script: function refresh() title.setValue("Confirm Unsummon") summons.setValue(QuickSummonUnsummon.describe()) end function onClose() QuickSummonUnsummon.closed() end

stringcontrol.name: warning
stringcontrol.static: Removing these summons clears their HP and conditions from the Combat Tracker. The last removal can be restored this session with /undounsummon.

button_text.name: unsummon
button_text.script: function onInit() setColor("FFFF5252"); end function onButtonPress() QuickSummonUnsummon.decide(true); end
